tools.name: check_esim_device
tools.title: Check a phone for eSIM
tools.description: Says whether a phone model is likely to take an eSIM (likely, unlikely or check), from the model name, with how to be sure on the phone itself. Call it before buy_esim when the customer is unsure.

device.description: The phone or tablet model, e.g. 'iPhone 13', 'Galaxy S23', 'Pixel 7a'.

tools.name: compare_esim_prices
tools.title: Compare eSIM prices across brands
tools.description: Compares travel eSIM prices for one country across every brand Inbox eSIM reads (about 50), cheapest first, for a size and a trip length. Read only. Each brand's cheapest plan that covers the request, with its price, the date that price was read, whether it needs an app or account, and its page. Inbox eSIM runs the comparison and also sells eSIMs: its row is marked is_ours and keeps its real position, because the order is by price only.

data_gb.description: Optional: at least this much data. Default 5.

unlimited.description: Optional: unlimited or daily plans instead of a data size.

min_days.description: Optional: valid for at least this many days. Default 30 (7 for unlimited).

tools.name: find_esim_plans
tools.title: Find travel eSIM plans
tools.description: Lists Inbox eSIM data plans for a destination (country, city, region such as Europe, or 'global'), cheapest first, with plan_id, data in GB, validity in days and price in USD. Data only, no phone number; works on unlocked eSIM phones.

min_data_gb.description: Optional: only plans with at least this much data.

min_days.description: Optional: only plans valid for at least this many days (the trip length).

tools.name: get_esim_checkout_link
tools.title: Checkout link for one eSIM
tools.description: Gives the page for one plan_id from find_esim_plans, where the customer checks the plan, confirms their phone takes an eSIM and pays on Stripe's secure page themselves. Nothing is bought until they pay there; the QR code is then emailed within about a minute.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Get an eSIM order's status
tools.description: Where an Inbox eSIM order is (awaiting_payment, preparing, ready_to_install, installed, in_use, ended, refunded, cancelled, with_support), with data used, the end date and the order page. Needs the order number and the email it was bought with.

order_id.description: The order number, e.g. 'ISJPAH2PXG2C' (in the paid response and the email).

customer_email.description: The email the order was bought with.

tools.name: make_esim_cart
tools.title: One payment for several eSIMs
tools.description: For a trip to several countries (or several phones): turns 2 to 6 plan_ids from find_esim_plans into one cart link. The customer opens it, checks the eSIMs and pays once on Stripe; each eSIM comes in its own QR email and can be refunded on its own if never installed. 3 or more eSIMs in one cart are 5% off. Nothing is bought until the customer pays on the page.

plan_ids.description: plan_ids from find_esim_plans, one per eSIM, e.g. ['japan-5gb-30d', 'south-korea-3gb-30d'].
